panels.description: List of all deployments on your SageMaker HyperPod cluster

targets.expr: label_replace(group by (resource_name, resource_type, model_name, model_version, instance_type, model_container_type, model_container_image) (model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}), "pd_role", "$1", "resource_name", "(prefill|decode)-.*")

count by (resource_name) (count by (resource_name, pod_name) (max_over_time(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))

count by (resource_name) (count by (resource_name, node_name) (max_over_time(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))
group by (resource_name, accelerator_partition_type) (model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"})

panels.title: List of Active Deployments

panels.description: Incoming requests per deployment per second
panels.title: Incoming Request Rate per Deployment

panels.description: Total number of incoming requests successfully served by the model over total number of incoming requests

targets.expr: (1 - ((sum by (resource_name) (rate(model_errors_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum by (resource_name) (rate(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST"}[5m])))) * 100

panels.title: Percentage of Successful Requests

panels.description: Number of requests that were successfully processed by the model vs number of requests that failed to get a response from the model

targets.expr: sum by (resource_name) (increase(model_latency_milliseconds_count{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST", status=~"2.*"}[5m]))

panels.title: Successful Requests vs Failed Requests

panels.description: Number of incoming requests that failed to get a successful response from the deployed model split by error codes.
panels.title: Count of Failed Requests per Error Code

panels.description: Time it takes for an incoming request to get a successful response from the model

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(model_latency_milliseconds_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST", status=~"2.*"}[5m])) by (resource_name, le))

panels.title: Latency of Successful Requests

panels.description: Time it takes for the model to send the first byte of response to an incoming request

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(model_ttfb_milliseconds_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST", status=~"2.*"}[5m])) by (resource_name, le))

panels.title: Time To First Byte (TTFB)

panels.description: Helps to identify if the latency of a response by the model was mainly due to delays in initial processing (first byte)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(model_ttfb_milliseconds_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST", status=~"2.*"}[5m])) by (resource_name, le)) / histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(model_latency_milliseconds_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource", method="POST", status=~"2.*"}[5m])) by (resource_name, le))

panels.title: TTFB to Total Latency Ratio

panels.description: Total number of concurrent requests being processed by each deployment
panels.title: Total Concurrent Requests

panels.description: Total infrastructure allocation - pods and nodes per deployment

targets.expr: count by (resource_name) (count by (resource_name, pod_name) (max_over_time(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))

count by (resource_name) (count by (resource_name, node_name) (max_over_time(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))

panels.title: Infrastructure Allocation (Pods & Nodes)

panels.description: Active pods currently receiving incoming requests  per deployment

targets.expr: count by (resource_name) (count by (resource_name, pod_name) (rate(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m]) > 0))

panels.title: Active Pods (Receiving Traffic)

panels.description: Time it takes for the model to create the first token for an incoming request

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate(tgi_request_queue_duration_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m]))) + histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate(tgi_batch_inference_duration_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",method="prefill", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))) * 1000

panels.title: Time to First Token (TTFT)

panels.description: Average time it takes for the model to generate two consecutive tokens across all tokens. Determines streaming responsiveness for TGI deployments

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate(tgi_batch_forward_duration_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",method="decode", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m]))) * 1000

panels.title: Inter-Token Latency (Decode)

panels.description: Number of tokens generated per second by the model. Represents efficiency and capacity indicator for TGI deployments

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate(tgi_request_generated_tokens_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))

panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Average time it takes for the model to generate every token required to respond to an incoming request

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate(tgi_request_mean_time_per_token_duration_bucket{cluster_id="$cluster_id",resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"$resource"}[5m])))

panels.title: Mean Time Per Token

panels.description: Average time it takes to generate a token per request over last 10 consecutive requests
panels.title: Mean Token Latency

panels.description: Average number of tokens per second per request over last 10 consecutive requests
panels.title: Mean Token Throughput

panels.description: Average total output tokens generated per request over last 10 consecutive requests
panels.title: Mean Output Tokens per Request

panels.description: Average rolling batch size — indicating concurrency during batching — calculated per request over the last 10 consecutive requests
panels.title: Rolling Batch Size
LMI (Large Model Inference) Token Metrics - aggregated over every 10 requests
KVCache L1 Cache Usage
panels.description: L1 (local) cache usage for KVCache

panels.title: KVCache Hit Rates
panels.description: KVCache lookup hit rates

panels.title: KVCache L2 Cache Usage
panels.description: L2 (remote) cache usage for KVCache

panels.title: Router CPU Usage
panels.description: Router CPU utilization percentage

panels.title: Router Memory Usage
panels.description: Router memory utilization percentage

panels.title: Router Queries per Second
panels.description: Router queries per second

panels.title: Router Latency
panels.description: Router average latency

panels.title: Router Request Queue Status
panels.description: Router request queue status - running and waiting requests

panels.title: Prefill & Decode Replica Count
panels.description: Active prefill and decode pod count.

panels.title: Request Routing Split
panels.description: Requests routed in the selected time range. Long prompts (above routing threshold) take the DPD path, shorter ones go directly to the decoder.

panels.title: Request Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of successful (2xx) responses per deployment role.

targets.expr: (1 - ((sum by (resource_name) (rate(model_errors_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"(prefill|decode)-.*", method="POST"}[5m])) or sum by (resource_name) (rate(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"(prefill|decode)-.*", method="POST"}[5m])) * 0) / sum by (resource_name) (rate(model_invocations_total{cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"(prefill|decode)-.*", method="POST"}[5m])))) * 100

panels.title: E2E TTFT — Time to First Token (p90)
panels.description: End-to-end time from request arrival to first token, including prefill, KV transfer, and decode startup.

panels.title: Decode Inter-Token Latency (p90)
panels.description: Time between consecutive tokens during decode. Lower values improve streaming responsiveness.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate({__name__="vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket", cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"decode-.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: Prefill Compute Time (p90)
panels.description: GPU compute time for the prefill phase on prefill pods.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate({__name__="vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_bucket", cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"prefill-.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: Prefill TTFT (p90)
panels.description: Time to first token on prefill pods, primarily reflecting prefill compute time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_name, le) (rate({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket", cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"prefill-.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: Queue Depth
panels.description: Requests waiting and running on DPD pods. High waiting values indicate saturation.

targets.expr: sum by (resource_name) ({__name__="vllm:num_requests_waiting", cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"(prefill|decode)-.*"})
sum by (resource_name) ({__name__="vllm:num_requests_running", cluster_id="$cluster_id", resource_type=~"$resourceType", namespace=~"$namespace", resource_name=~"(prefill|decode)-.*"})

panels.title: In-Flight Prefill Requests
panels.description: Prefill requests currently in-flight at the router. Sustained high values indicate saturation.

panels.title: Prompt Tokens (rate)
panels.description: Rate of input (prompt) tokens processed across DPD pods per second.

panels.title: Generation Tokens (rate)
panels.description: Rate of output (generation) tokens produced across DPD pods per second.

panels.title: DPD Routing Decisions
panels.description: DPD vs direct-to-decoder routing decisions over the last 5 minutes.
